Friend,
Outside a high school in Breese, Illinois, an area that national Democrats have long abandoned, the Proud Boys put up a massive billboard recruiting young people into their racist, extremist gang:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrrsms-bb?refcode=250930_rrr_billboard [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrrsms-bb?refcode=250930_rrr_billboard]
We saw it. We refused to let it slide. And Resist Reclaim Rebuild acted.
Our team came together, pooled resources, and put up a billboard of our own — one that called out the Proud Boys for exactly what they are: violent, hate-filled extremists:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrrsms-bb?refcode=250930_rrr_billboard [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrrsms-bb?refcode=250930_rrr_billboard]
And guess what? The Proud Boys’ billboard is now GONE! Taken down. Removed.
But you and I both know this fight doesn’t end in Breese. Extremist groups are recruiting across the country. If we don’t push back, they grow bolder.
Resist Reclaim Rebuild is ready to keep going — to meet hate head-on wherever it shows its face. But we can only do that if our movement has the resources to keep fighting. Can we count on you to chip in $100, $20, or even just $15 today to help us keep fighting back against MAGA Extremism? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrrsms-bb?refcode=250930_rrr_billboard]
DONATE TODAY TO HELP DEFEAT MAGA EXTREMISM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrrsms-bb?refcode=250930_rrr_billboard]
Every dollar you give helps us push back against extremism, call it out publicly, and make sure young people see that there is another way forward.
We can’t let hate win. Together, we won’t.
In strength,
The Resist Reclaim Rebuild Team

subject: LEAKED Poll: Haaland is up 6. But, here's the catch....
body:
Plus: NM ranks 4th in taxes — 50th in income | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/oCE6r6RL5Bd?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
A poll just leaked. [It's the first real look at the New Mexico Governor's race since the primary](https://us.list-manage.com/kduCvxJDU09?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) — and the numbers behind the headline tell a story the press isn't going to tell you.
Deb Haaland leads Gregg Hull. That's the topline. Underneath it, there's a clean hit Hull has on her that nobody is talking about.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/TcwJWh9MtSl?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🔥 **LEAKED POLL — HAALAND UP 6, BUT THE CRACKS ARE REAL**
The poll went into the field June 9-11 from one of the best firms in the country, and we got a look at every question and every answer in it.
The topline shows Haaland up 6, but the breakdown is where it gets interesting. She's running a 14-point net gender gap with men, and 72% of voters say Haaland is liberal even though only 32% of them describe themselves that way.
The fracking ban is where Hull has his cleanest shot. Even with soft polling language, 44% of voters said it would make them less likely to support her. The real question now is whether Hull is willing to actually throw the punch.

🚨 **$113 MILLION TAX HIKE — THE ONE COUNCIL JUST KILLED IS BACK**
City Council voted 8-1 to reject this in March. Albuquerque Councilor Brook Bassan brought it back anyway — and this time, it's headed to the November ballot.
Half a penny on every dollar. $113 million a year. Funding a project that another councilor — Tammy Fiebelkorn — called a "vanity project."
We pulled the spending data. Albuquerque city spending is up 68% in 10 years.
---
| [Stream No Doubt About It Podcast Now](https://us.list-manage.com/jPFZImdeikK?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
💰 **NM RANKS 4TH IN TAXES — AND 50TH IN INCOME**
That's not a typo. We rank fourth in the country for total tax burden. We rank dead last for median household income — $25,000 below the U.S. average.
And the city wants to raise the tax again. We do the math.

😂 **ELON MUSK BECOMES FIRST TRILLIONAIRE — CNN IMPLODES**
The SpaceX IPO Friday was the largest in history. $75 billion raised. Musk briefly worth more than $1 trillion on paper. 4,400 SpaceX employees became millionaires overnight.
Bakari Sellers went on CNN and said no one should be "allowed" to have that much money. Scott Jennings's response is one of his best of the year.

body:

| | | | | |
# **Join Forces with Jonny**
---
| | Hi Friend,

Trump has launch a bid for his latest pet project. Now that his name – illegally placed on the Kennedy Arts Center – has been removed, he is trying yet another angle to plaster his infamous legacy in Washington. The “Triumphal Arch” proposed to be placed within the George Washington Memorial Parkway in Washington, D.C. I feel I stand with the many when I say this is a massive waste of taxpayer money, and clearly not addressing the affordability crisis nationwide. You can do something! Submit your comment in opposition for this joke of a project [here](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=fad5989cc1&e=c29ddb867a). There is strength in numbers.
We’ve met so many of you on the campaign trail, and couldn’t continue without taking a moment to thank you for your help! Truly, nothing happens without you!
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | |
Our friend, [Becky Moss](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=66e86d8d13&e=c29ddb867a), is a long-time advocate for LGBTQ+ rights here in Utah, and as a foster parent also my second mom! We’re so grateful to have her support.

---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
We are happy to have the endorsement of the Utah [Women’s Democratic Club of Utah](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=8caf65d085&e=c29ddb867a). This amazing organization of women work hard to get democrats across the state elected. Thank you for the support!
---
| |
---
| |
We are also pleased to have endorsements from the Utah Labor Caucus, Utah Stonewall Democrats, Center for FreeThought Equality, Utah Veterans’ Caucus, Salt Lake County Progressives Caucus, Young Democrats of Utah, and AANHPI Democratic Caucus.
We are thankful for all the support we receive, and truly the more donations we receive, the more we can get out and meet you! We’d love you to join our coalition of volunteers, or consider donating to the campaign!
Yours in solidarity.

Semper Fi,

Jonny

---
|
---
| |

U.S. Rep. Adriano Espaillat (D-NY) walks through the U.S. Capitol on February 10, 2026 in Washington, DC. Photo by Heather Diehl/Getty Images.
A surge of last-minute support from major pro-Israel donors, including AIPAC's former president Bob Cohen, has flooded into the campaign of Rep. Adriano Espaillat, who faces a formidable primary challenge from local community organizer Darializa Avila Chevalier in New York's 13th congressional district.
On a single day, June 4, 2026, Espaillat raised just under $112,000 from 69 wealthy donors at an average of $1,623 per contribution. Not a single donor listed an address inside Espaillat's district, which encompasses Harlem and surrounding areas, and 48 of the donors have also given large amounts of money to the American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) since 2023. That number goes up to 67 out of the 69 contributors if you include donations to AIPAC-adjacent organizations like Democratic Majority for Israel and the Republican Jewish Coalition. At least 44 of the new Espaillat donors have given heavily to Republicans.
The pro-Israel money comes amid a multimillion-dollar push to rescue Espaillat, chair of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, in the waning days of a campaign that ends on June 23. Espaillat and the New York Post have teamed up over the past week to hammer Avila Chevalier, who has the support of the local Democratic Socialists of America chapter as well as Justice Democrats, for a series of unapologetically leftist tweets, as well as for her attendance at a rally on October 8, 2023, for a ceasefire in Gaza, which her critics say came too early.
As AIPAC's money has grown increasingly toxic, the organization has relied heavily on funneling money through shell PACs or directing donors straight to a candidate. When reporters then identify the link between the donors and the candidate, AIPAC cries foul, saying it's unfair to single them out. If the numbers at play were small, or the contributions themselves were not from major AIPAC donors, they might have a point. But the calvary coming to rescue Espaillat is not a collection of modest AIPAC donors--it's major funders of the organization. Cohen, a national AIPAC board member, has raised tens of millions for the group and led the push against President Obama's Iran nuclear deal. His real estate firm, R.A. Cohen & Associates, often clashes in New York City with local activists. Six of the donors have given $428,000 to AIPAC's super PAC, the United Democracy Project. Since 2023, the few dozen donors have given nearly a million dollars directly to AIPAC and another half million to GOP candidates.
The financing helps explain why Espaillat continues to take politically toxic positions in his campaign even as he faces an ignominious defeat at the hands of a previously unknown activist.
At a recent debate, Espaillat once again refused to describe Israel's assault on Gaza as a genocide, instead describing it vaguely as a "horrific situation," and avoided acknowledging Israel as the culprit, saying, "whoever perpetrated that action should be held to the highest standard of accountability." The congressman [dodged debate questions](https://substack.com/redirect/b0cb7b4a-913b-4f80-8173-06a696538dc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about pro-Israel Super PAC spending on his behalf and the more than $676,000 in direct contributions he has accepted from AIPAC, saying, "my values are those of the people that I represent. They tell me how to vote."
Espalliat has [taken contributions directly from AIPAC](https://substack.com/redirect/a53b65ef-8302-4653-8ced-8ca2b4db2c9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as recently as March 18, and has joined congressional delegations to Israel on the lobby's dime. Through Democracy Engine--a payment processor used by AIPAC that allows donors to route money directly to multiple candidates at once--his campaign has received an additional $376,398.
Since early May, Espaillat has benefitted from [more than $3.3 million in outside spending](https://substack.com/redirect/a510dfc9-7d7f-4425-a7e9-92c0b39121e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from three super PACs that brand themselves as advocates for issues facing the Latino community.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHJvcHNpdGVuZXdzLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.xTnrqdU758KDoRKUp1Tcz6nMVS5emn7gp5NDkK5e5xM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=202205431)
BOLD America, responsible for more than $2.5 million of these three groups' outside spending for Espalliat over the last month, appeared effectively destitute by Super PAC standards in its last FEC filing before the spending push, [reporting](https://substack.com/redirect/e1055496-4cca-4db7-b88d-3244e6c03f62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) less than $250,000 total cash-on-hand. Of the fundraising it _has_ declared, [$50,000 of it was raised](https://substack.com/redirect/5682b3ce-579b-4510-aebd-f7d31b0050b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Coinbase, the largest American cryptocurrency company, and $150,000 from International Bancshares Corporation, the largest minority-owned bank in the country.
The name BOLD America appears to be an effort to sound like BOLD PAC, the primary vehicle used by the Congressional Hispanic Caucus since Espaillat was elected chair in November 2024.
That leaves $2.25 million in secret money backing Espaillat, which won't be disclosed until after the election. The dozens of pro-Israel donors listed on his June 4 disclosure, however, certainly have the capacity to have funded the Super PAC as well.
Groups backing Avila Chevalier have decried the covert spending maneuvers used to skirt disclosure requirements.
"The fact that Super PACs spending over $4 million attacking Darializa will not have to disclose their donors until after this election is exactly the kind of political corruption that voters are so fed up with from AIPAC stooges like Adriano Espaillat," said Usamah Andrabi, communications director for Justice Democrats. "If you're going to let them bankroll your campaign, at least own up to it."
On May 8, Latino Victory Fund spent $475,000 on ads supporting Espaillat. Ten days later, on May 18, BOLD America spent another $600,000 on pro-Espaillat advertising. Four days later, on May 22, Latino Victory Fund poured an additional $50,000 into the race, $46,500 backing Espaillat and $3,500 attacking his opponent Avila Chevalier.
The Congressional Hispanic Caucus's BOLD PAC has [taken money directly from AIPAC](https://substack.com/redirect/136882d1-3bb6-40bd-ab3c-5ea04da62223?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) this cycle, then dumped roughly $230,000 behind Espaillat on June 1, followed by more than $730,000 from BOLD America over the next two days. On June 9 and 10, BOLD America reported [spending](https://substack.com/redirect/cda6a66d-e7d1-4164-be70-f4ab9f93364a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) yet another $1.2 million primarily on attack ads against Avila Chevalier, as the progressive insurgent was climbing in the polls.
Latino Victory Fund, by comparison, [had](https://substack.com/redirect/ccdb5687-b650-4ae7-8d7e-be8c8de2539e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) $912,725 cash-on-hand. CHC Bold PAC, the official spending arm of the caucus, was even more [flush with cash](https://substack.com/redirect/835c148f-40a0-4350-af56-fcaf5b187f5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at $3,297,278, but spent less than $230,000 of the total $3.3 million dump.
For Super PACs that file quarterly reports, the last one on record only covers money raised through March 31, 2026. The next quarterly report isn't due until after the June 23 primary, meaning much of the money can be concealed until after votes are cast.
This massive dark money spending push comes as Avila Chevalier has secured key endorsements from NYC DSA and Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who [promised](https://substack.com/redirect/4fbd9b46-bd25-4ac2-9e18-6345233decba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to back Espaillat for reelection last summer, according to Rep. Nydia Velasquez.
Avila Chevalier has benefited from the backing of super PAC [spending](https://substack.com/redirect/c12a64fc-2e7f-4c79-8174-d36ecca3db8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Justice Democrats and American Priorities to the tune of about $1.3 million total. American Priorities is a new super PAC organized to challenge candidates backed by AIPAC; Justice Democrats, which recruited Avila Chevalier, backs left-wing Democrats.
The race between Avila Chevalier and Espaillat reflects an ideological battle for control of the post-Trump Democratic Party. Espaillat represents an establishment wing of the party with close ties to institutional power players, even though he himself previously challenged the incumbent in the seat at the time, Charlie Rangel. For her part, Avila Chevalier--now being dubbed DAC-- has embraced more combative positions throughout her campaign, [running significantly to the left of AOC](https://substack.com/redirect/7ad537e9-1806-4240-8616-fb85b86fa3db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
"We need to stop sending our tax dollars to a state that is currently enacting a genocide, a word that my opponent has yet to say," Avila Chevalier said during the June 12 debate. "There cannot be peace when the American taxpayer dollar is continuing to be used to slaughter civilians."

Nydia Velasquez. Avila Chevalier has benefited from the backing of super PAC from Justice Democrats and American Priorities to the tune of about $1.3 million total. American Priorities is a new super PAC organized to challenge candidates backed by AIPAC; Justice Democrats, which recruited Avila Chevalier, backs left-wing Democrats. The race between Avila Chevalier and Espaillat reflects an ideological battle for control of the post-Trump Democratic Party. Espaillat represents an establishment wing of the party with close ties to institutional power players, even though he himself previously challenged the incumbent in the seat at the time, Charlie Rangel. For her part, Avila Chevalier--now being dubbed DAC-- has embraced more combative positions throughout her campaign, . "We need to stop sending our tax dollars to a state that is currently enacting a genocide, a word that my opponent has yet to say," Avila Chevalier said during the June 12 debate. name: Elijah Norton for Arizona Treasurer
subject: To manage $32 billion of your dollars, we need experience!
body:
The Treasurer's job is often overlooked, but it is extremely important.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/BRTfmM9s7dr?e=4bbfddebd7&c2id=3a28d4e25e67509d3bf28128bdefbc4b)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Hello Peter,
My name is Elijah Norton, and I am running to be your next state Treasurer.
The Treasurer's job is often overlooked, but it is extremely important. For example, did you know the state budget and your tax burden are directly related to the success the Treasurer has in state investment performance?
The State Treasurer manages over $32 **billion** of your money and determines how your money is invested. This is why it is imperative that we elect someone with investment and finance experience to this role.
I have lived the American dream - at 21 years old I started a business with just a dream and $1,000. Today, it generates nearly half a billion dollars in annual revenue, operates across the United States and around the globe, and employs nearly 400 people. As the owner of a global insurance organization, I directly manage and oversee the investment of over $100 million of claims reserves. I must invest those reserves according to NAIC investment guidelines, which are more conservative than the guidelines the State Treasurer has to follow. **I want to apply this experience to safely achieve the best returns for you,** **prioritizing safety over liquidity and liquidity over yield.**
In addition to putting my experience to work for you, I want to work with our legislature to **conduct a DOGE-style audit of our entire public education system and state budget to expose the waste, fraud, and abuse rampant in our public education system.** I did this when I served as the Treasurer of the Arizona Republican Party - where I was trusted to manage over $20 million in donations ($10 million of which was spent directly on electing President Donald J. Trump). As AZGOP Treasurer, we had one of the most successful election years in recent history - with President Trump having the biggest victory of any swing state, we added seats to our legislative majorities, and kept both of our swing congressional seats in Republican hands.
My work as the AZGOP Treasurer stabilized and strengthened the Party. Gov. Katie Hobbs has decimated Arizona’s finances. I’m the only candidate for state Treasurer with the experience to stabilize the state finances and make Arizona strong again.
This office requires someone you can trust - with proven investment and finance experience. We also need someone who can beat the Democrat in November. There hasn't been a Democrat Treasurer since 1967 - and for the first time the Democrats have nominated someone who can win. He has already raised **over a million dollars.** He has investment experience (albeit, bad experience) and would be absolutely terrible for our state.
I was the first person to enter this race on either side, and I am working around the clock to win this race and bring my business and finance experience to work for you, the taxpayers of Arizona, but I need your help!
But I can’t do it alone. I need your help. [**Please consider signing up to be a volunteer for our campaign.**](https://us.list-manage.com/189sSJ8QGug?e=4bbfddebd7&c2id=3a28d4e25e67509d3bf28128bdefbc4b) We have opportunities you can help with, either from the comfort of your home or in your neighborhood. Grab a yard sign, tell your friends and neighbors, and help us reach your friends, family, and neighbors, or phone bank!
Arizona cannot afford to have someone with no background in finance or investments managing $32 billion of your dollars - **or worse** \- a far-left radical Democrat like Nick Mansour.
Thank you for your consideration and support!
Elijah Norton

If you would like to get fewer emails, [**_click here._**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/59469?t=1&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w) If you would like to unsubscribe, [**_click here._**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/59470?t=2&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w) [](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=3&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w) Team, this is Mary Trump.

You may know me as the author of _Too Much and Never Enough,_ or as someone who has spent years sounding the alarm about my uncle, Donald.

[**Yesterday, I launched Transcend PAC to fund the candidates fighting Donald's corruption every day, who will strengthen the democracy my uncle is trying to destroy. If you can give, please split a donation between Transcend PAC and Fight For Reform, and then read on to learn why I believe this moment calls for something transformational.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=4&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w) | [BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR TODAY >>](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=5&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w)
---
* * *
[**Here's what I need you to understand about my uncle: Donald is a weak man.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=6&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w)

That might seem like an odd thing to say about somebody who holds such a powerful position, but that's exactly the danger. Every day, as Donald deteriorates – psychologically, emotionally, and cognitively – he grows more desperate, increasing the risk to the rest of us.

Strong people do not rig the system in their favor. They don't silence critics. They don't seek to control the institutions designed to hold them accountable. [**Donald does all of those things — because he has to, and he knows it. His behavior isn't evidence of strength – it's evidence of its absence.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=7&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w)

The comprehensiveness with which Donald and the complicit Republican party are attempting to dismantle our institutions and take away our rights, in service to maintaining their hold on power and self-enrichment, should also make clear what is at stake.

Under Donald’s so-called leadership, the Republicans in Congress have stood by while our nation’s alliances have become strained; illegal wars have been started; and our institutions have been weakened and, in some cases, dismantled entirely.

I believe we are going to prevail. But when corrupt leaders like Donald and the sycophantic enablers in his inner circle go unchecked or unchallenged, they can do enormous damage. The antidote is to assemble a coalition of people who refuse to look away and are willing to take action.

[**That’s why I’ve launched Transcend PAC. Together, we’ll fund candidates who believe in public service and who will work to fulfill the promise of American democracy.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=8&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w) Because we deserve representatives who understand what’s at stake and are prepared to meet the moment.

[**If you're able, please split a donation between Transcend PAC and Fight For Reform today. Your contribution funds the organizing and the advocacy that will ensure no voice is silenced and all of our voices are heard. Every dollar will go toward undoing the damage my uncle and the Republican Party have done so we, together, can build something better.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=9&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w)

An unexpected setback.
| **Congress Proposes Zero Funding for Public Broadcasters' Educational Programming** Despite a judge's DEMAND to resume funding for public broadcasters, Congress STILL hasn’t acted and public media is STILL underwater.

**If we don’t act FAST, we could lose these critical networks for good!**

[**Public broadcasters need to know we have their backs! So we’re gathering 10,000 signatures by MIDNIGHT to stay in the fight and show our solidarity »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/112842?t=6&akid=25257%2E878179%2Ek4QaB6) | [**Chip in $3 to sign now »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/112842?t=7&akid=25257%2E878179%2Ek4QaB6)

TO: Public Broadcasters
FROM: A grateful Democrat
Subject: Thank you! To all public broadcasters,

Thank you. Thank you for enriching all of our lives — in rural and urban areas, and everywhere in between — with your various news and educational programs.

I couldn’t be more THRILLED to see Trump’s disgusting executive order blocked. _His authoritarian power grab didn’t stand a chance against our fight._

**But until your funding is resumed, I won’t stop fighting. I also know that his attempts to SILENCE the free press won’t end here.**

It’s not just upsetting, _it’s a dangerous step towards an**outright dictatorship!**_ That’s why I’m not getting complacent.

[**I’m signing this letter today by chipping in $3 to VPP to thank you for your years of service and to join VPP in the fight against Trump’s attacks on the free press. name: Stacy Garrity
subject: Welcome to the team!
body:
Thanks for joining our campaign for a stronger Pennsylvania.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | | Peter,

Thank you for signing up and joining our campaign for Governor.
Over the past several years, I have had the privilege of serving as Pennsylvania's State Treasurer. During that time, I've traveled to all 67 counties every year because I believe public service starts with listening to the people you represent.
What I've heard is clear.
Pennsylvania families are struggling with rising costs. Too many young people are leaving our Commonwealth in search of opportunity elsewhere. Businesses face unnecessary obstacles, energy costs continue to rise, and too many people feel like state government is working for politicians instead of hardworking taxpayers.That's why I'm running for Governor.
I spent 30 years serving our nation in uniform, retiring as a Colonel in the Army Reserve. I also spent 30 years building a career in manufacturing. I've spent my life solving problems, leading teams, and getting results.
As Treasurer, we've returned more than $1 billion in unclaimed property, protected taxpayer dollars, strengthened Pennsylvania's finances, and modernized state government. Now, I'm ready to bring that same record of service and leadership to the Governor's Office.

But I can't do it alone.
This campaign is going to be powered by Pennsylvanians from every corner of our Commonwealth who are willing to stand up and fight for a better future.If you're ready to help, there are two important ways to get involved today:

Together, we can build a stronger, safer, and more prosperous Pennsylvania.

Hey folks,
When we were kids, we learned about the Scientific Method. My teacher had a big poster with all of the steps:
💡 Find a question to investigate.
📝 Make predictions.
🔬 Gather data.
📊 Analyze the data.
🤔 Draw conclusions.
It’s the exact approach I applied in medical school and in diagnosing and caring for patients in the intensive care unit. It’s the same way I lead, now, in Congress.
When I was a kid, my grandmother lived with us, and she had diabetes. I learned to dress her wounds and wondered, why don’t we all have the same access to medical help?
At first, I assumed there had to be a simple explanation. But as I moved through medical school and treated patients, I gathered the evidence.
I saw insurance companies deny care. I saw drug companies jack up prices. I saw families take on debt, work extra jobs, and postpone treatment just to stay afloat. Now, the MAGA movement is cutting programs like Medicaid and SNAP, and it’s just getting worse.
The data is clear.
And the conclusion is simple: healthcare is a human right, and every single American deserves affordable, high-quality healthcare.

## Flash Flooding Causes Chaos
[Life-threatening flash flooding](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD3OpDAMQE8DXVB-mDAUKbahm223RIY4ECkhKPEMcPsVs3uDr_STZb3nP6_xBT74bfkNEQ2dLo0bHiUgEeYxg9-mFKcD8ua3ZfKLkOWNhUbJpWZcM6FHCz5cY1tbM3HbixqN6J5C8-4pVL0aPoNQYu4ewPteqklrgb2wwEX3bPsWam_uY1wLLQRXSjXcWctBoeOznKx-VC1H6ynlhlYkPKG4cKUP5mZOsQ5mJdpLpX5VcqjkcBxH49J5IND6b6WSA56UMSL7Tys5FETmia0In4vdnYyyXxbMhQXvkNGaEQjvbOYClJW5kJK9R5hzKoV9TdieU0x04_gO5PeADCPmBbf5YhnL_MZSZ2P3w4fgi-6qli8RfPjK089e_jHybwAAAP__6vabcQ) slammed Texas on Monday as a surge of tropical moisture fueled torrential rain, triggering overnight water rescues and road closures from the coast to the interior. In Waco, [all lanes of Interstate 35](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO6yAURL_G7rAu2OCkoHiNu7x2S-tiwL4ShgjYkPz9yvsL200xmtE5X4_1gRQo7v_xdLq-fVqjayW4Wl1eM1I06TQNc6S4G9q5KN-u1FWAUAwU42q1SOGzTr3VBuyd907z-cYVzDc-9oeWBiVYj27m0tu7R8nRKAlSbjcB96knfY2B4opzGMdxAG8t4Og8bMJYJbsJnKWa8lAPV90biw-f9HJ52NLZB33U-izd-K8TSyeW1trg03u6MK5CJ5YrdmLxAcvBfEjJUtxZqRmjLcxmerlcGLFRsoZb6rO2z0YhUFFzN8F-IoXfr_o3Qy8tfgIAAP__JJN7uw) were submerged, stranding drivers until state troopers opened an access road to guide stalled southbound motorists around the high water; no injuries were reported. First responders pulled trapped motorists from nearly submerged cars in McLennan County, while Austin closed dozens of low-water crossings and Boerne, hit with 3 to 8 inches of rain, shut its trails. In Bandera County, crews [searched for a driver](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3O4yAURJ_G7oj4cbBTUGzjLttuaV3gYl8JQwQkjt9-5dW-wVfOaDQ6On-eyxMoUlp_w46mfUNeEh41YmtYlgKUbN7tASVRWi2tQtY31rZILjXjmgm9eKB4LkPvjeX-IXo0YpyE5uMkVL8ZlI_BgruDEH4a-BUHMQmnnFMjh9CTuc64FloIrpS68eA9B4WBO2m9vncDR08tl1vbsOEXaohn_mC5ubz30WytvWqnfnVy7uR84Q8VEqSWE-Vr87_t5Byzg9jJuSIUtzGXU6P0xsooMQvJYwEGBYGFXNgHN3IRWT3w1RgccDJ7shBz9gc0LLUvxr8OipGqHruBrztQ_AfVfqbyY-TfAAAA__94sYt5) whose vehicle was swept away on Lower Mason Creek Road before dawn. Contact was lost, and the person remained missing.
## Forecasters Warn of 'Rain Bomb'
Just hours after catastrophic flooding hit Central Texas, Houston forecasters are warning of a potential ["rain bomb"](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OozAQRZ8GOqMZmxgoXGyTLttuicZ4AEsGR7Y3JG-_crRv8HXzIx3dc_885gf54M_tNx1synuN88lXDlwKpzmRP2087EXp9Odm_YYy_-VcZglSC9AC9ezIh8_ct85YcBO2bHAYUcMwomp3Q9N6Q5JgceoXHBenkUdFAFY5O0y69abCQKNGBKVUB6tzQIpXWKR1-tb0wM6XmLqyc-E35TV84otTt8SjDWYv5Zkb9auR90ber-vqPrTHWL-NvFedemYqOyfxf6VU_BK4jpnFFypWWjiL6iyqtMBejfI2atnt5QhtMu55-RB81kPTw3aQD98E5We9vYz8FwAA__8v04HO) that could dump up to a foot of rain across Southeast Texas by midweek. The National Weather Service said Monday that a stalled front merging with a weak tropical disturbance could unleash 4 to 7 inches region-wide, with isolated spots seeing 8 to 12 inches or more. The danger is the pace. Moisture could support rainfall rates of 2 to 5 inches per hour, with some areas getting 4 to 8 inches in as little as three hours. Harris County meteorologist Jeff Lindner [reported](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykUM2O2yAYfBp8i_UBNtgHDlWrqKmU5tb2ZvFro2LjBTYk-_SrJI-wt_nTaDR_z9NZ-uC3-bdcrSg3F6fN1hxsKTZNSfpNxVVVmTa_zcrPmOR3m8tEgLADsANmk5E-3KeuMUKBGXFjBeYDZsAHTJtFcKoVYC3xoBi3vYRejT3rNe20o3rkjRePMmCYYQyU0hacMSCpdaCJMqxHHVjjS0xtWWyxN5lduMerTa2OaxPEUsqeEf2GyBGRY621dVJbFeP_RwCRYy4x3dt92RF94ckpbxD9gYEQRoF0hI4dx3xEhL2MgQ4DwAgdImz1yt7KU6_138klRFgyT55Z2i-_Lqfv8PH2k25_miTMXn0IPjOOOphX6cNzZvnauVdBPgMAAP__BpGJ6A) that the heaviest totals will fall between Houston and Beaumont, with Galveston also in the bullseye. Houston faces [flood risk for four straight days](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLtuxCAURL8Gd17xWmwXFJEid5smilJasFzwVTCsgH39feTNJ6Sa4khHM_N9Wk4GI6bwYTbQ7eHzkuBeI7QGZSkGk82bvZuSMAWLgfF6hdoWTrnqqeqZWpzB-Fxk57SlbmIdaDaMTNFhZKJbtQXpPZucnIxXMI3MHp0cqJRCMO-U61DvMqqYYowKIQ7UO0eNAE_P3Dp1JJKCw5bLoa3Q4GGqj898g3I4562Lem3tUol4I3wmfDb2vC_YGeHz1yfhszMpQMnX2vuYs8MU-pxC3vOl6300df2DfcH6U_sCAXMifK4tlycRMzoi3pkQ40ilYl3R7nLHGLGqgUgaNoPxVaf978Sb5r8BAAD__3mdhtg), Monday through Thursday, with a five-day total possibly reaching 10 inches.
## Sorsby Parts Ways With Texas Tech
Texas Tech quarterback Brendan Sorsby and the program have[ mutually parted ways](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2urCAURp8GOww_DnoLitvYzW1vaTayVRKECWzH8e1PnFc49ZesfGv9f05PCDGk9R_saOmz5CnhWSMSYZkKhOTy7k4oKaTVhVWqemClSQlluDBcmslDiNfUNd464f_IBq3sB2lEP0jdbHZGJXTvlFDOq04NZtDCPxC0HqAHkE2wN0wYaaQUWutWLN4L0LiIWTlvHqwT6APl0tKGhB-oS7zyG0s7572JdiN6Vab_MjUyNZ7n2eak742p8ZZhanQFk4fEay7VXfwL4YTzxveDDojx4i8oxE-4KoeFsPAVdneH4XWG5CHyiCtEvkCM-SCmxqZY_zpDjKGannVi3SHE7yX6Xci3VT8BAAD___Y9iiE), ending one of the messiest eligibility sagas in recent college football history. He was set to be paid around $5 million to play for the Red Raiders. Sorsby was declared ineligible by the NCAA earlier this spring after admitting to placing thousands of wagers since 2022, including bets on Indiana games while he was redshirting there. A Texas court temporarily restored his eligibility, but the opposition was swift: The Big 12 and NCAA [fought back through legal channels](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O3SAUhVeDOyzADuYVFGncTdqU1gWuMRKGJ7gZj3cfeZQdpDvF0Xd-fn9sH5ByKvEXnGjpa69bwatnJMK2NUjF1dNd0Eoq0aUoVf-DnTYllOZCc6m3ACnf2zwE60R4yQGtXIzUYjFyGg6rjVyMWwCDEjCDDC_jX9qYAM4Ev8gh2QcmtNRSimmaRrGHIGDCXXjlgv7BZoEhUW0jHUj4BX3Pd_3ENvp6DtkeRO_Opp9MrUyt13WN3vX-ro3642Bq9TVnjMj3WslBzkytz0qmVpcil4pnjJA5eEq1cNewBCi819bdzb8TOaE__kkgqq3gzSMWbPDQhmbD-0o5p64XNot4Qsrf9ej_Tv206m8AAAD__wvdjrk), and schools like Georgia and Nebraska vowed to boycott Texas Tech across all sports. Texas Tech booster Cody Campbell [released a statement](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OszAQAJ_GdIl212YNhYtP-USXa69EdrwQSwYi7Py9_Sn3CtdOMSPN93k8-5TTOn_5RVx9Tdu4yrNkqVX2cfdpDdsSnn5f0zqHNCOVu5Q6EhAfgA_IY_Qpv0fTRBcg9tiIQ9shg-1QN1cnHeBkuWutDX3oJZgpGt33F2tYY-ub5D4yYGRE0FofYYoRvJYJLhQit8qAxFS3_VivUuXly5Tf20P242Vbmuyutd6K0v8UDYqG14cqGk5bfJ_YKBpK9fVeFA0EzNwjsdUAmk3bo9JDUfo_QbO7eHumnFNhqwzMi0_5N1D_tuXh6CcAAP__765xuA) defending the program's handling of the situation, saying the Red Raiders "acted with the utmost integrity in following all NCAA protocol, provided complete transparency and cooperated with them in every possible way." He also confirmed that Texas Tech will not seek NIL reimbursement from Sorsby for money paid out to date. Sorsby, who checked into a residential treatment program for gambling addiction earlier this spring, has since applied for the [NFL supplemental draft](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uwyAURp8Gb7YuPyFmYOjiLV07WhAuNhLGFtzEydtX6St0_vSdI52f23xzKaeyfLsNLb3iPhc8W0YirHN1qfh986erJZXFp4WL9sBGswChe9A913NwKb9n1QXrIRjeoeXXkWu4jlx2q1WaG6kuFxAYjRrBj-oOEf0oRVRGmS7ZDww015yDlHKAGAI4iRHuwgd9YQowJNrrQCsSvlyL-b0_sQ73feuyXYmOxuQXExMT03meA7ajfEYmphIzE1Ojvb6ZmGYmphSYmJQBqYzRn8PqqC8x9-1xHBk3LORyH6qL1FUbjjPlnJq-MgXL5lL-s9L_Wj2t-A0AAP__1RR8KA), which will be held later this summer.
